A fast and entertaining take on this topic: "Why Tipping Should Be Banned - Adam Ruins Everything" - [VIDEO]

"Why Tipping Should Be Banned", by Adam Ruins Everything is worth watching if you are of the school of thought that tipping is bad: [VIDEO] The gist of the video is that if you're tipping, then a waiter/waitress for example is not being paid enough, and tips are deliberately designed to bolster their unfair income.

story: Why the Restaurant Industry Hates Postmates
text: Isn't this article really more about the problem with the food service industry relying on tips instead of paying their workers a proper wage. [VIDEO] Postmates isn't intentionally preying on the industry, the industry was set-up this way, with the expectation of tips being paid by customers, but the model is changing. If the restaurants charged the actual price they expect to get for their product, then the issue would become what the couriers get paid, which may be too low, but then the market would/should decide on what is fair.

story: What Minimum-Wage Foes Got Wrong About Seattle
text: If the large chain won't adjust, that seems something that would give smaller businesses an advantage, and seems like a positive to my ears. As for tipping, people don't tend to tip based on quality of service (see Adam Ruins Everything) [ [VIDEO] ], and instead tends to be based more on attractiveness and ethnicity. A normal wage is fairer.
